arguments.question: What should "recent" cover, and what would you like to see about those transactions?
suggestions: List the 50 latest transactions (the data ends 2019-10-31), with amount, type, merchant category and error
Summarise October 2019: count, total and average amount, broken down by transaction type
Show the daily transaction count and labelled fraud rate for the last 30 days of data (2019-10-02 to 2019-10-31)
